    Monte Carlo power for the PPI++ mean estimator

    simulate_power_ppiplus_mean.Rd

    Resamples labeled/unlabeled splits from a superpopulation data frame and recomputes the PPI++ estimator to estimate power empirically, while also reporting the oracle analytical power.

    simulate_power_ppiplus_mean(
  df,
  N,
  n,
  theta0,
  alpha = 0.05,
  R = 2000,
  lambda = NULL,
  lambda_type = c("oracle", "plugin", "user"),
  use_sample_var = TRUE,
  seed = 1
)

    Arguments

    df

    Data frame containing columns y and fhat_cf.

    N

    Unlabeled sample size.

    n

    Labeled sample size.

    theta0

    Null value for the mean.

    alpha

    Two-sided significance level (default 0.05).

    R

    Number of Monte Carlo replicates (default 2000).

    lambda

    Optional user-specified blend weight.

    lambda_type

    "oracle" (default), "plugin", or "user" to define how the blend is chosen inside each draw.

    use_sample_var

    Logical; use draw-level variance estimates (TRUE) or plug in full-population variances (FALSE).

    seed

    RNG seed.

    Value

    List with empirical and analytical power, average SE, oracle blend, and per-draw details.
